item.title: China’s Massive New Artificial Island In The South China Sea Emerges, Primed For Militarization
item.summary: What was a submerged reef a year ago is now a 1,500 acre artificial island with a large runway under construction, as China's militarization of the South China Sea accelerates. The post China’s Massive New Artificial Island In The South China Sea Emerges, Primed For Militarization appeared first on TWZ .
